title: Self-Pay Terms for In-Person Appointments: Attendance History and the Fee Offset in a Late-Cancellation Refund
content:
**Term.** On a late-cancelled In-Person Appointments visit, the starting amount of the late-cancellation fee the refund offsets is raised according to the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account, counting no-show fee and late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the refund date:

- where the ledger shows 2 or more such charges, at least one of them a no-show fee, it is raised by half (multiplied by 1.5);
- where the ledger shows at least 1 such charge but not that combination, it is raised by a quarter (multiplied by 1.25);
- where the ledger shows none, it is taken as it stands (multiplied by 1).

Charges of any other kind are not counted for the late-cancellation fee the refund offsets.

**Paired cases (hypothetical ledgers, refund dated 2026-12-01).**

| Ledger inside the 12 whole months | Combination met | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| One no-show fee charge and one late-cancellation fee charge | Yes: 2 charges, one a no-show fee | 1.5 |
| Two late-cancellation fee charges | No: 2 charges, none a no-show fee | 1.25 |
| One no-show fee charge | No: only 1 charge | 1.25 |
| One late-cancellation fee charge, date of service 2025-11-15 | Not counted: outside the 12 whole months | 1 |
| No appointment fee charges; an office visit copay only | Not counted: other kind | 1 |

*Hypothetical figure:* a starting amount of $75.00 raised by a quarter is $93.75; raised by half, $112.50.
